title: Always Up To Date Config
description: Configuration for the always-up-to-date CLI. Lives at .always-up-to-date.json in the project root.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON schema. Enables IDE autocomplete and validation.

beyondRange.description: How far past its package.json range a dependency may move, to its latest version. "none" stays within each range, so exact pins are held. "patch", "minor" and "major" allow a step up to that size, and apply to exact pins too.

rules.description: Per-package overrides, keyed by package name or a * glob such as "@types/*". An exact name beats a glob; among globs the longest pattern wins. "hold": never update. "followRange": stay within the range even when beyondRange allows more. "latest": always move to the latest version.

allowMinorUpdates.description: Deprecated: use "beyondRange": "minor". Let a dependency move past its package.json range, to the latest version, when that is at most a minor step (e.g., 1.2.x → 1.3.0). Ignored when beyondRange is set.

allowMajorUpdates.description: Deprecated: use "beyondRange": "major". Let a dependency move past its package.json range, to the latest version, up to a major step (e.g., 1.x → 2.0.0). Ignored when beyondRange is set.

updateAllowlist.description: Deprecated: use a "latest" rule. Package names that always move to their latest version. A matching rule wins.

updateDenylist.description: Deprecated: use a "hold" rule. Package names that are never updated. A matching rule wins.

depsDev.description: Look up versions of packages served by the public npm registry (registry.npmjs.org, registry.yarnpkg.com) through deps.dev, Google's open-source dependency service: about 8 KB per package on the wire instead of a registry document that can run to megabytes. Each such package name is sent to api.deps.dev, including private packages published to registry.npmjs.org. Names from any other registry, including a scope's own registry, are never sent. false reads everything from the registry.

cooldown.description: Hold off on suggesting versions newer than this. Accepts a number (days), a duration string ('1 week', '24h', '7 days'), or a per-update-type object whose values are themselves numbers or duration strings.

oneOf.description: Cooldown window in days (applied to every update type).
Duration string ('1 week', '24h', '7 days'). Bare numbers are interpreted as days.
Per-update-type cooldown windows. Missing keys default to 0.
